relation_statement: Token dispatch locations must be recomputed from the current routing mask after any capacity update so that dispatch and combine address the same slots, under no-token-drop gating.
observable_signal: dispatch/combine round-trip mismatch: tokens scattered into expert slots inconsistent with the current mask/capacity (combine maps experts back to wrong tokens)
validity_precondition: MoE topk gating with drop_tokens=False and expert load varying across ranks (capacity raised via all_reduce MAX)
evidence_from_issue: drop_tokens=False does not recompute locations after capacity update — dispatch positions stale
evidence_from_fix: old locations from a stale earlier mask are used to scatter tokens into expert slots, so tokens go into the wrong dispatch positions

relation_statement: The sliding-window mask value at each (query,key) pair must equal the logical AND of both one-sided window conditions under guard that a two-sided sliding window is configured.
observable_signal: mask entries that are True where only one of the two window conditions holds (attention reaching outside the window on one side)
validity_precondition: flex-attention backend selected with a two-sided sliding-window attention configuration
evidence_from_issue: sliding-window mask used Python `and` on tensors — short-circuit returned wrong mask
evidence_from_fix: Python's `and` short-circuits on bool() of the first operand, never producing the intended logical AND; the mask was computed as a single one-sided comparison

relation_statement: Tied word-embedding replicas on different pipeline stages must remain identical after every optimizer step (hence must be routed to the same optimizer) under PP>=2 with tied embeddings.
observable_signal: Checksum/norm of the tied word_embeddings replica on PP rank 0 vs the MTP-only last stage after each optimizer step; divergence witnesses the split AdamW-vs-Muon routing.
validity_precondition: Muon optimizer enabled, MTP-only final PP stage owning a tied word_embeddings replica, share-embeddings-and-output-weights active
evidence_from_issue: tied word_embeddings on MTP-only last PP stage routed to Muon instead of Adam
evidence_from_fix: is_embedding_or_output_parameter only set when pre_process is True ... the two tied copies receive different optimizer updates (AdamW vs Muon Newton-Schulz), causing silent divergence

relation_statement: Expert parameters must be re-sharded on resume using the true expert-data-parallel world size (dp/sp), so each rank restores exactly the slice it saved, under sequence parallelism.
observable_signal: per-rank expert parameter checksum before save vs after load; recorded dp_world_size field vs seq-adjusted dp world size
validity_precondition: MoE module present with sequence_parallel_size > 1 across a save/load cycle
evidence_from_issue: MoE checkpoint records dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size — wrong replication factor on resume
evidence_from_fix: loader uses this value to re-shard expert tensors, producing the wrong split; each EP-rank loads weights for the wrong slice and starts from corrupted parameters

relation_statement: Per-parameter optimizer state after elastic checkpoint reload must equal the state saved for that same parameter, honoring the nccl alignment padding used at save time, when world size changes.
observable_signal: per-parameter optimizer state (e.g. exp_avg) checksum before save vs after load
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 1/2 elastic checkpoint loaded with a different world size and load_optimizer_states=True
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO 1/2 elastic checkpoint optimizer state alignment ignores nccl_start_alignment_factor
evidence_from_fix: alignment used for re-flattening merged optimizer state was just world_size, but ZeRO pads by nccl_start_alignment_factor * world_size when saving; per-rank slices were misaligned and silently restored to the wrong parameters

relation_statement: Exactly one rank must write each consolidated non-ZeRO checkpoint file per save operation under MiCS partitioning.
observable_signal: count of ranks writing the same checkpoint file path per save (more than one witnesses the race)
validity_precondition: MiCS sharding with world_size > mics_shard_size and save_checkpoint called on all ranks
evidence_from_issue: MiCS save_non_zero_checkpoint True on every rank — checkpoint files race-overwrite each other
evidence_from_fix: save_non_zero_checkpoint became True for every MiCS rank because zero_optimization_partition_weights() is True under MiCS; all ranks wrote the consolidated file, racing and leaving inconsistent contents

relation_statement: The gradient accumulation buffer must be allocated in the user-configured grad_accum_dtype rather than a hard-coded dtype.
observable_signal: dtype of the flat gradient-accumulation buffers vs configured grad_accum_dtype at init
validity_precondition: bf16 model without ZeRO, explicit grad_accum_dtype=bf16 requested in config
evidence_from_issue: BF16_Optimizer fp32 grad accumulator allocated as fp32 even when grad_acc_dtype is bf16
evidence_from_fix: ignored the requested grad_acc_dtype and always allocated fp32_groups_gradients_flat as fp32; step-time cast silently down-cast accumulated values

relation_statement: The gradient buffer consumed by the optimizer must be the same buffer written by backward (decoupled_grad) under Megatron-FSDP with a fused optimizer.
observable_signal: parameter values unchanged across optimizer_step despite nonzero decoupled_grad norm
validity_precondition: Megatron-FSDP parameters optimized by FusedAdam with precision-aware optimizer (gradients written to param.decoupled_grad)
evidence_from_issue: FusedAdam.use_decoupled_grad not set for Megatron-FSDP, gradients silently ignored
evidence_from_fix: use_decoupled_grad flag was never set to True, so the optimizer kept reading param.grad (None or stale), silently skipping the actual gradient update

relation_statement: The QK normalization axis of the cloned model must match the per-head normalization of the reference architecture under guard that the model claims equivalence to that reference.
observable_signal: none_runtime: within a single run nothing violates; divergence is observable only against an external reference implementation's attention scores
validity_precondition: reference-clone model config where the reference uses per-head QK norm
evidence_from_issue: Qwen3Clone-8B script forgot use_head_qk_norm — used per-channel QK norm instead of per-head
evidence_from_fix: the default per-channel QK norm was applied instead, normalizing across the wrong axis and producing different attention scores from the reference Qwen3

relation_statement: The pipeline partition boundary list must be a monotone cover assigning at least one layer to every stage when constructing pipeline modules.
observable_signal: per-stage layer or parameter count (a stage owning zero layers/parameters witnesses the violation)
validity_precondition: pipeline parallel with num_stages > 2 and uniform layer weights
evidence_from_issue: Pipeline partition_balanced returns degenerate partitions, last PP stage can be assigned zero layers
evidence_from_fix: binary-search probe returned a non-monotone boundary list like [0,2,4,5,5] for 5 items / 4 parts — the last stage owns 0 layers; pipeline modules silently train with a stage holding no parameters

relation_statement: Every loss component entering the weighted sum must be normalized by the same divisor (token count) as its siblings under guard that the component is active in the combined loss.
observable_signal: magnitude of the un-normalized component exceeding its configured weight share by a factor ~ seq_len*batch_size relative to normalized components
validity_precondition: distillation transformer with the embed-loss component enabled in the weighted-sum loss
evidence_from_issue: H-Net embed loss never normalized by loss_div_factor — wrong loss weighting
evidence_from_fix: the finalize call was omitted for hnet_embed_loss; the component entered the weighted sum as a raw sum, inflating its effective weight by roughly seq_len * batch_size

relation_statement: The offloaded gradient accumulation buffer must conserve the sum of per-microbatch gradients across all microsteps of one global step when gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 under ZeRO-2 with CPU offload.
observable_signal: accumulated gradient norm/checksum at the accumulation boundary vs the running sum of per-microstep gradients
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 2 with CPU-offload optimizer and gradient_accumulation_steps > 1
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-2 + CPU offload micro_step_id off-by-one and wrong copy/accumulate gating
evidence_from_fix: copy/accumulate gating used `not is_gradient_accumulation_boundary` for copy, which copies on every non-boundary microstep instead of only the first

relation_statement: Gradient reduction must fire exactly once per gradient-accumulation boundary, not once per micro-batch, under pipeline + sharded-optimizer training.
observable_signal: count of gradient all-reduce/reduce-scatter launches per optimizer step vs expected one per accumulation boundary
validity_precondition: pipeline parallel combined with ZeRO stage 2/3 and gradient_accumulation_steps > 1
evidence_from_issue: gradient accumulation boundary flag never propagated, ZeRO does early reduction every micro-step
evidence_from_fix: engine never told the optimizer whether it was at a real GAS boundary; reduction kicked off on every micro-batch, destroying accumulation correctness

relation_statement: The document packing order must follow the intended sort order of the length key without unsigned-integer wraparound under guard that keys are negated for descending sort.
observable_signal: packed-document sequence violating the intended (descending) length ordering; negated uint32 keys wrapping to huge positive values
validity_precondition: document packing path that sorts documents by a uint32-typed length key
evidence_from_issue: Document packing sort overflow — uint32 * -1 wraps to huge positive
evidence_from_fix: root_cause not provided in the curated record

relation_statement: The reduce-and-partition stream must be ordered after the stream that produced the gradients (the current stream) before reading the bucket under ZeRO-3.
observable_signal: nondeterministic gradient checksums across identical reruns, or gradient mismatch vs a fully synchronous baseline execution
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with asynchronous reduce_and_partition_stream and gradients produced on a non-default stream
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-3 reduce_and_partition_stream syncs against wrong CUDA stream
evidence_from_fix: __add_grad_to_ipg_bucket uses default_stream() instead of current_stream() for reduce_and_partition_stream synchronization

relation_statement: Each attention projection's init std must use its actual fan-in (in_features) rather than a single d_model**-0.5 under guard: GQA / w_out fan-in differs from d_model.
observable_signal: Per-projection init weight std vs the fan-in-derived expected std.
validity_precondition: InitMethod.claude selected, GQA (n_kv_heads!=n_heads) or w_out where in_features!=d_model
evidence_from_issue: Attention claude-init uses d_model**-0.5 instead of actual w.in_features**-0.5
evidence_from_fix: single std=d_model**-0.5 assumed identical fan-in across Q/K/V and w_out, scaling init wrong

relation_statement: The layer-to-pipeline-stage assignment computed by the hybrid model stack must equal the global transformer layer offset map under uneven first/last stage configurations.
observable_signal: per-rank layer offset from the Mamba stack vs get_transformer_layer_offset (mismatched layer types/weights vs checkpoint)
validity_precondition: hybrid Mamba models with num_layers_in_first/last_pipeline_stage set (uneven layer distribution across PP stages)
evidence_from_issue: Mamba hybrid PP layer selection ignores uneven first/last stage configuration
evidence_from_fix: offset = pp_rank * (num_layers // pp_size) assumed even partitioning; MambaStack disagreed with TransformerLayer.get_transformer_layer_offset, silently mismatching layer types/weights vs. checkpoints

relation_statement: The number of key positions each query can attend to must equal the configured sliding-window size under guard that sliding-window attention is enabled.
observable_signal: per-row count of unmasked attention positions compared against the configured window size (off by one)
validity_precondition: attention configured with a sliding window
evidence_from_issue: Sliding window size off-by-one — window 1 token too small
evidence_from_fix: root_cause not provided in the curated record

relation_statement: Temp filenames must be unique across concurrent ranks/processes and not collide under identical RNG seeds under guard: parallel preprocessing of the same path.
observable_signal: Distinctness of per-rank tmp_path values; collision / FileNotFound on replace.
validity_precondition: multiple ranks preprocess same path with same global seed, memmap_to_write used
evidence_from_issue: memmap_to_write tmp filename uses seeded random — concurrent writers collide on identical path
evidence_from_fix: temp name via random.randint seeded by global RNG; identical seeds gave identical tmp_path across ranks

relation_statement: The MoE auxiliary loss must be scaled by num_tokens under per-token loss mode so its weight stays consistent with the main loss normalization.
observable_signal: auxiliary-loss contribution relative to the main loss under per-token mode vs the sample-mean reference
validity_precondition: MoE auxiliary load-balancing loss with calculate_per_token_loss enabled
evidence_from_issue: MoE aux loss not scaled by num_tokens in per_token_loss mode
evidence_from_fix: root_cause not provided in the case record

relation_statement: A user-configured field must survive the configuration serialize/reconstruct (merge) round-trip with its configured value under guard that CLI overrides are merged.
observable_signal: effective freeze_experts value after merge differing from the user-specified value; router gradients for the first expert half unexpectedly zero
validity_precondition: config class whose field is set in __init__ rather than declared; any override applied via the merge path
evidence_from_issue: freeze_experts assigned in __init__ instead of dataclass field — OmegaConf merge dropped it
evidence_from_fix: the serialize/reconstruct merge drops fields not declared as dataclass attributes; freeze_experts always reverted to the default regardless of the configured value, silently zeroing the first half of router gradients

relation_statement: The manual scale_loss/backward path must apply the same expert-parallel output-gradient scale as engine.backward, so expert gradients are identical across the two API paths.
observable_signal: expert-gradient norm ratio between manual-backward and engine.backward runs on identical inputs (expected 1, observed 1/ep_size)
validity_precondition: AutoEP MoE present and user drives backward via engine.scale_loss(loss).backward() (e.g. HF Trainer integration)
evidence_from_issue: manual loss.backward path skips ep_size loss scaling — parity with engine.backward broken
evidence_from_fix: manual path forgot the AutoEP-specific multiplication by _autoep_output_grad_scale that engine.backward applies; expert gradients undercount by ep_size

relation_statement: All-reduced gradient norms must be normalized by the number of model replicas so the reported norm equals the true single-replica value under HSDP.
observable_signal: Reported grad_norm vs the norm computed inside one replica: inflation by exactly the replica count N witnesses the hardcoded num_model_replicas=1.
validity_precondition: FSDP HYBRID_SHARD with num_model_replicas > 1 and metric collection enabled
evidence_from_issue: Optimizer collects metrics with num_model_replicas == 1 hardcoded, so HSDP norms are N times too large
evidence_from_fix: each replica contributed identical gradient norms; without dividing by the replica count, all_reduce sums them and the reported norm is N times the true value, leading to spurious clipping decisions

relation_statement: The input gradient of a tensor-parallel linear layer with frozen weight must be all-reduced so it is identical across all TP ranks after backward.
observable_signal: cross-rank checksum of grad_input within the TP group after the frozen-weight linear backward
validity_precondition: linear layers whose weight has requires_grad=False (frozen), linear_with_frozen_weight code path
evidence_from_issue: LinearWithFrozenWeight backward forgets to all-reduce grad_input across TP
evidence_from_fix: backward returns grad_input without all-reducing across TP ranks; each rank only sees its column-shard of grad

relation_statement: The learning rate must decay (non-increase) after the warmup peak rather than hold constant under guard: DeepSpeedTrainer post-warmup.
observable_signal: Learning-rate trajectory over steps after warmup completes.
validity_precondition: DeepSpeedTrainer in use, training long enough that decay matters
evidence_from_issue: DeepSpeed scheduler set to WarmupLR instead of WarmupDecayLR (no decay phase)
evidence_from_fix: WarmupLR only ramps then holds LR constant; intended WarmupDecayLR ramps then linearly decays
